entities.summary: Ondřej Němec is a Czech professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for Severstal Cherepovets of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Pittsburgh Penguins in the 2nd round of the 2002 NHL Entry Draft.
